description.value: Event-related task presenting alcohol or water visual cues followed by delivery of alcohol or water tastes, including congruent and expectation-violation trials.

spans.text: During this event-related task (Fig. 1 ), each trial began with the presentation of a visual cue (alcohol or water; 2 s) such that the words Alcohol or Water were visually presented to participants (cues). This was followed by a fixation cross (jittered for an average of 3 s), delivery of the taste (2 ml alcohol or water; 5 s) and a fixation cross (jittered using an exponential distribution with a mean of 3 s and a range of 0.5–6 s).
